description:
Title: Car Service

The police has a new app to remind you of your car service.
The process is started after a successful service.
When a service is necessary, the system checks if your car is still registered.
If it is registered, you are notified.
If you do not go to the service, you are fined after 30 days.
At the car service facility the mechanic enters the problems of your car for reference.
While you wait (can take several days), you get status updates via email.
You can pay through the app, when the repair is done.
The mechanic enters that the repair was successful and you got your "Pickerl".
The mechanic enters the time for you next service.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_CarService" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/car-service">

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ServiceRecord" name="Successful service recorded"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ServiceDue" name="Service due notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_CarDelivered" name="Car delivered for service"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_VisitRecorded" name="Service visit recorded"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_StatusUpdate" name="Repair status update email"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PaymentPossible" name="Repair done, payment possible"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Payment" name="Payment made through app"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CarService">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Police" name="Police Service Reminder App" processRef="Process_Police"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Facility" name="Car Service Facility" processRef="Process_Facility"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Owner" name="Car Owner"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_NotifyOwner" name="Service due notification" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Participant_Owner"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_CarDelivered" name="Car delivered" sourceRef="Participant_Owner" targetRef="StartEvent_CarDelivered"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_VisitRecorded" name="Service visit recorded" sourceRef="Task_SendVisitNotice" targetRef="Catch_VisitRecorded"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_StatusUpdate" name="Status update email" sourceRef="Task_SendStatusUpdate" targetRef="Participant_Owner"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PaymentPossible" name="Payment possible" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentPossible" targetRef="Participant_Owner"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Payment" name="Payment made" sourceRef="Participant_Owner" targetRef="Catch_PaymentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ServiceRecord" name="Successful service and next service date" sourceRef="Task_SendServiceRecord" targetRef="StartEvent_ServiceRecorded"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Police" name="Police Service Reminder" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ServiceRecorded" name="Successful service recorded">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ServiceRecorded" messageRef="Msg_ServiceRecord"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckServiceNecessary" name="Check if service is necessary"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckRegistration" name="Check if car is still registered"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Registered" name="Car registered?" default="Flow_NotRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyOwner" name="Notify owner of service due" messageRef="Msg_ServiceDue"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotRegistered" name="No reminder (car not registered)"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitService" name="Wait for service" eventGatewayType="Exclusive"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_VisitRecorded" name="Service visit recorded">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_VisitRecorded" messageRef="Msg_VisitRecorded"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Timer30Days" name="30 days without service">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_30Days">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P30D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ServiceVisited" name="Service visit completed"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_IssueFine" name="Issue fine"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_FineIssued" name="Fine issued"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P1" sourceRef="StartEvent_ServiceRecorded" targetRef="Task_CheckServiceNecessary"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P2" sourceRef="Task_CheckServiceNecessary" targetRef="Task_CheckRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P3" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegistration" targetRef="Gateway_Registered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Registered" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="Task_NotifyOwner">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${isRegistered}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotRegistered" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="EndEvent_NotRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P5" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Gateway_WaitService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P6" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitService" targetRef="Catch_VisitRecorded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P7" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitService" targetRef="Catch_Timer30Days"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P8" sourceRef="Catch_VisitRecorded" targetRef="EndEvent_ServiceVisited"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P9" sourceRef="Catch_Timer30Days" targetRef="Task_IssueFine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P10" sourceRef="Task_IssueFine" targetRef="EndEvent_FineIssued"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Facility" name="Car Service Facility" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CarDelivered" name="Car delivered for service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CarDelivered" messageRef="Msg_CarDelivered"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterProblems" name="Mechanic enters car problems for reference"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendVisitNotice" name="Report service visit" messageRef="Msg_VisitRecorded"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendStatusUpdate" name="Send status update email" messageRef="Msg_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RepairCar" name="Repair car"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RecordRepairSuccess" name="Mechanic enters successful repair and issues "Pickerl""/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPaymentPossible" name="Notify repair done, payment possible" messageRef="Msg_PaymentPossible"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_PaymentReceived" name="Payment received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Payment" messageRef="Msg_Payment"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterNextService" name="Mechanic enters time for next service"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendServiceRecord" name="Send successful service record to app" messageRef="Msg_ServiceRecord"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ServiceCompleted" name="Service completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F1" sourceRef="StartEvent_CarDelivered" targetRef="Task_EnterProblems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F2" sourceRef="Task_EnterProblems" targetRef="Task_SendVisitNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F3" sourceRef="Task_SendVisitNotice" targetRef="Task_SendStatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F4" sourceRef="Task_SendStatusUpdate" targetRef="Task_RepairCar"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F5" sourceRef="Task_RepairCar" targetRef="Task_RecordRepairSuccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F6" sourceRef="Task_RecordRepairSuccess" targetRef="Task_SendPaymentPossible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F7" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentPossible" targetRef="Catch_PaymentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F8" sourceRef="Catch_PaymentReceived" targetRef="Task_EnterNextService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F9" sourceRef="Task_EnterNextService" targetRef="Task_SendServiceRecord"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F10" sourceRef="Task_SendServiceRecord" targetRef="EndEvent_ServiceCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>
